verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs describe a Git-driven workflow. Content changes can be made via Git (docs-1), each pull request gets its own preview URL before merging to production (docs-17), branch-specific preview deployments are supported (docs-49), and PRs can be reviewed and merged from the editor (docs-12). Automations trigger on repository pushes (docs-5), the agents open PRs in your docs repo (docs-4, docs-53), and a hands-on user confirms the GitHub app integration exists (comm-4). Missing for 10: an explicit statement that merging to the default branch auto-publishes to production, and evidence of Git hosts beyond GitHub (e.g., GitLab or self-hosted Git).
